review_output: {"summary":"Read-only review of the 4 owned files for the WP12 unavailable branch. I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issues. Comparing BEFORE and CURRENT, only copy and tests changed. The vendor-scoped query, the requireVendorFinance gate and route argument, the export href with prefetch=false, the table columns, the status tone map, the invoice field names, the required/pattern/minLength/maxLength attributes, invoiceFieldError, invoiceValueFromForm and the disabled fieldset behavior are all unchanged. Both pages now say automatic electronic invoices are not available. They no longer promise automatic scheduling after payment, and they state that payment success, a saved invoice request or an exported record does not mean an invoice was issued. The new copy makes no provider, account, tax-exemption or legal-entity claims, and no SMS work appears. The unchanged job and route dependencies agree with the copy: with no adapter, the job returns adapterAvailable=false (HTTP 202) and rows stay queued. Remaining items are wording precision, accessibility polish and test coverage gaps. Residual risk outside this scope: other screens, emails or the CSV column headers may still contain issuance wording; the scope restriction kept them out of this review. I did not run any tests, so nothing here confirms that tests pass.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/app/(app)/billing/electronic-invoices/page.tsx","area":"Status label copy","issue":"The new label for queued rows means 'pending processing'. That still suggests the system will process and issue the invoice later, but on this branch no fiscal adapter exists and queued rows are never processed.","evidence":"labels.queued changed from the term for 'queued' to the term for 'pending processing'. The unchanged runElectronicInvoiceJob returns early when input.adapter is missing, and the route always calls it with no adapter, so queued rows never move to another status.","impact":"Merchants may read queued rows as work in progress that will finish without them. This weakens the unavailable notice and could lead them to skip issuing invoices manually.","recommended_fix":"Use a neutral label meaning 'not issued (request recorded)' or 'request only'. Change display copy only; keep the stored status value and the tone mapping as they are.","required_test":"Update the queued-row test in page.test.tsx to expect the new neutral label and to assert the 'pending processing' term is absent.","confidence":0.7},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/app/(app)/billing/electronic-invoices/page.test.tsx","area":"Test coverage of disclaimer copy","issue":"The page tests check the banner title and the absence of the old auto-scheduling phrase. They do not check the key disclaimer sentence, and they do not check that the old export label (which meant 'export issuance report CSV') is gone.","evidence":"The tests assert the banner title, the new export label and the export href, plus not.toContain on the old auto-scheduling phrase only. Nothing asserts the sentence saying payment success, a saved request or an export does not mean an invoice was issued, and nothing asserts the old export label is absent.","impact":"A later copy edit could weaken or remove the core no-issuance statement, or bring back the issuance-report wording, without any test failing.","recommended_fix":"In the populated, empty and queued cases, assert the banner body sentence (including the phrase saying these do not mean an invoice was issued). Also assert the old export label and any automatic-issuance wording are absent.","required_test":"Run page.test.tsx on its own. All four cases must pass with the added positive and negative copy assertions.","confidence":0.65},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/components/checkout-invoice-fields.test.tsx","area":"Test coverage of retained validation and submission fields","issue":"The tests render only the default personal/member state. They do not check that company and donation inputs, or the mobile and citizen-certificate carrier inputs, still exist with the same names and constraints. They also do not check that the old legend, which promised electronic invoices, is gone.","evidence":"The static render checks the invoiceType options and carrier option values, the role=alert element and the notice text. The inputs invoiceBusinessId, invoiceCompanyName, invoiceDonationCode and invoiceCarrierNumber, with their required/pattern attributes, only appear after state changes, and no test drives those states. No not.toContain check on the old legend exists.","impact":"The requirement that all validation and submission behavior is kept is confirmed only by reading the code, not by tests.","recommended_fix":"Add interactive tests (for example with Testing Library) that switch the type and carrier and check input names, required, pattern, minLength and maxLength. Assert the inline error still shows on input. Assert the legend shows the new 'invoice request' wording.","required_test":"Run checkout-invoice-fields.test.tsx on its own. It should cover company, donation, mobile and citizen-certificate states, checking field names, constraints and the error alert.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/components/checkout-invoice-fields.tsx","area":"Option label copy","issue":"Some option labels still suggest a working e-invoice service: the 'personal electronic invoice' option and the 'member carrier (checkout email)' option. A member carrier depends on a registered carrier arrangement that this branch does not claim.","evidence":"The option text for personal and member is unchanged from BEFORE. The new notice above them says only invoice requests are collected.","impact":"Small risk that a buyer reads the member-carrier option as an available service. The notice mostly offsets this.","recommended_fix":"Optionally add a short qualifier to the option labels showing these are request preferences. Keep the option values (personal, member, mobile, citizen_certificate) unchanged so submission and validation are not affected.","required_test":"If the labels change, assert that the option values in the rendered HTML are unchanged and that the new label text is present.","confidence":0.45},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/components/checkout-invoice-fields.tsx","area":"Accessibility","issue":"Both static notices use role=status, which creates a live region. Screen readers may not announce content that is already there when the page loads. The checkout notice is also not linked to the fieldset.","evidence":"There is a p with role=status inside the fieldset, after the legend, and a div with role=status on the vendor page. Neither uses aria-describedby.","impact":"Screen reader users may never hear the no-issuance notice before filling in the invoice fields.","recommended_fix":"Give the checkout notice an id and add aria-describedby with that id to the fieldset. Consider plain text or role=note for static content, keeping role=status for content that changes.","required_test":"Render-markup test asserting the fieldset has aria-describedby pointing to the notice id.","confidence":0.5}]}
